method: Latest valid saved pregame forecast per game; side-specific recorded prices; matched sportsbook comparisons. All forecasts and qualified bets reported separately.

qualified.method: Only qualified plays actually saved before kickoff; no retrospective selection

props.note: Legacy tracked props are not presented as qualified bets. DFS entries need actual entry payouts to calculate ROI.

filters.policy: One policy for game details, Top 10, and saved qualified plays. Edge is measured against the offered price, not a synthetic no-vig price.
